Memory management and join/leave helpers for a capture context, plus a transaction status read-write lock.

# Purpose
`fd_capture_ctx.c` implements the life cycle for a capture context object that is stored in caller supplied memory. The functions [`fd_capture_ctx_new`](<#fd_capture_ctx_new>), [`fd_capture_ctx_join`](<#fd_capture_ctx_join>), [`fd_capture_ctx_leave`](<#fd_capture_ctx_leave>), and [`fd_capture_ctx_delete`](<#fd_capture_ctx_delete>) validate the memory block, check alignment, clear the storage, set up the embedded `fd_solcap_writer_t`, and use a magic value to detect valid and invalid states. The code also manages an internal buffer for account update data and uses memory fences to control visibility when the context is created and destroyed.

The file also defines a static read-write lock, `txn_status_lock`, and exposes four wrapper functions: [`fd_capture_ctx_txn_status_start_read`](<#fd_capture_ctx_txn_status_start_read>), [`fd_capture_ctx_txn_status_end_read`](<#fd_capture_ctx_txn_status_end_read>), [`fd_capture_ctx_txn_status_start_write`](<#fd_capture_ctx_txn_status_start_write>), and [`fd_capture_ctx_txn_status_end_write`](<#fd_capture_ctx_txn_status_end_write>). These functions provide synchronized access to transaction status data through `fd_rwlock` operations. The file is therefore a C implementation file that provides internal context management and thread-safe access control for capture-related state.
